question: Does the deposited neuron-targeted nuclei dataset carry a hormone-deprivation-like signature (hormone-target transcripts such as the hairless gene named in PMID36834863, parvalbumin-lineage genes, oligodendrocyte-lineage balance)?
design: Add a hormone-target and interneuron gene read to INV06 item X0 on the same deposited pools; no replicate structure invented; gene sets compared with size-matched random sets as in the module
endpoint: Transcript-level maturation composition and hormone-target output
endpoint_scope: Reports stage composition and target-gene output at transcript level in hippocampus nuclei; does not report sheaths, conduction, network activity, viability or hormone content
mechanism_control: none possible in pooled data; glial contamination notes of the NB-4 package apply
decision_it_changes: Signature present raises INV-12 and EX3 priority; absent lowers H1 without closing it
weakened_by: One pool per arm; hippocampus, not callosum; spheroid data cannot be used (no annotated oligodendrocyte population, NEED-MYELINATION O3)

question: What hormone baseline do the co-culture and spheroid media actually provide, and is receptor-target output lower in OPCs on null neurons?
design: Document the supplier composition of the B27 and N2 lots used; measure free hormone in conditioned medium of null and wild-type DRG co-cultures; read a receptor-target transcript in OPCs per arm. No perturbation
endpoint: Hormone availability and receptor-target transcript output
endpoint_scope: Reports availability and engagement of the pathway; does not report differentiation, sheaths or conduction
comparator: Wild-type DRG co-culture; a hormone-depleted medium and a defined-hormone medium as references
engagement_check: The receptor-target transcript is itself the engagement readout for EX3
decision_it_changes: If baseline hormone is absent or low in every arm, the dish readouts are hormone-limited by design and INV-12 needs the defined-baseline arm first; if present, the medium confound weakens (INV06:E12 stays for the spheroids)
weakened_by: Assay sensitivity; B27 composition is a supplier statement, not measured here

question: Does receptor activation release the maturation block only on null neurons, and is the effect separable from contact, substrate and activity?
design: INV-12 co-culture extended: neuron genotype (null, wild-type) x medium baseline (hormone-depleted, defined hormone) x ligand class (tiratricol, liothyronine comparator, a receptor-beta-leaning isoform control, vehicle); plus the fixed-null-neuron arm of INV06:X1 and the activity-block arm of INV06:X2; independent experiments are the unit (at least two), coverslips are not replicates; two read times
endpoint: Differentiation stage shares (PDGFRa, BCAS1, CC1) and sheath proxy (MBP wrapping, EM g-ratio where reachable); add a viability stain
endpoint_scope: Reports differentiation and sheath formation in the dish plus viability; does not report conduction (not measurable in a dish), network activity, maturation timing beyond the two read times, or any in vivo effect
comparator: Functional comparator: a non-receptor enhancer arm taken from INV06:X3 so a count rise without wrapping would show; wild-type neurons are the non-specific and adverse-effect control
mechanism_control: Fixed null neurons (substrate only), activity block (INV06:X2), medium baseline arm; AMPK-active prodrugs excluded because of N07
engagement_check: Receptor-target transcript per arm (EX2) in OPCs; the isoform control must track its selectivity
decision_it_changes: Effect only on null: opens a pre-onset in vivo question under INV-12 (EX4). Both genotypes: non-specific maturation, WWOX-specific reading closed. Neither, with engagement shown: close this route. Medium-only effect: spheroid-type confound
weakened_by: Engagement not shown; no inflammatory or deiodinase context needed; cultured peripheral neurons differ from cortical axons
not_a_substitute_for: EX4, seizure control, or any statement on development

question: Conditional on EX3 (null-specific effect): in tissue, does receptor activation within the early window raise sheath formation and conduction, and is the effect separable from seizure change?
design: Neuron-targeted deletion mice and Cre-negative controls, treated and vehicle arms in both genotypes, early window only (the model dies at 3 to 4 weeks); compared with the neonatal enhancer discordance of INV06:X3; bursting recorded alongside
endpoint: Sheath formation (EM g-ratio, myelinated axon fraction) and callosal compound action potential latency with a structural control (EM and nodal markers on the same animals)
endpoint_scope: Reports sheath formation and conduction; "latency up" is slower conduction. Does not report seizure control, survival, growth, development or quality of life
comparator: Vehicle and treated Cre-negative controls; the neonatal clemastine discordance as functional comparator
mechanism_control: Bursting and thyroid-axis status recorded so seizure or systemic effects are not read as myelin
decision_it_changes: Justified in vivo only because function (conduction, ultrastructure) needs tissue and only after a null-specific dish result; decides whether INV-12 rises or closes
weakened_by: Mosaic Cre; 3-mouse scale; thyroid-axis suppression in the source model (N04)
not_a_substitute_for: EX3; a clinical or symptom comparison

question: Do oligodendrocyte-lineage and neuronal nuclei in the deposited dataset express the glucose and lactate transporters and glycolytic genes, and do they shift with genotype?
design: Descriptive read of SLC2A1, SLC16A1, SLC16A7 and the six-gene glycolysis module in the same pooled nuclei as INV06:X0, next to the P47T module result already held (O5)
endpoint_scope: Reports expression of transport and glycolysis genes; does not report energy availability, flux or myelin
comparator: S-Control pool; size-matched random gene sets
decision_it_changes: Shows whether the OL lineage has the uptake machinery in this tissue; low priority, cannot set the sign
weakened_by: Pooled; transcripts do not give flux; the module result is inconclusive (p near 0.06)

question: Do null neurons consume and release glucose and lactate differently from wild-type neurons in the co-culture medium, and when does blood glucose fall in the neuron-targeted line?
design: Glucose consumption, lactate release and respiration/acidification (the existing minimal falsifier named in card E04) in null and wild-type DRG cultures at matched axon density in the co-culture base medium; record the glucose concentration of that medium; in S-KO and S-Control mice blood glucose at P9, P13, P17
endpoint: Energy availability (neuronal metabolic output) and blood glucose over time
endpoint_scope: Reports energy availability and timing; does not report differentiation, sheaths or conduction
mechanism_control: Same medium lot and cell density; fixed neurons as zero-metabolism reference
decision_it_changes: Sign decides Arm A (lower output), Arm B (higher output) or neither; blood glucose before or after P13 sets whether hypoglycaemia can precede the P17 myelin readout

question: Conditional on EX6 showing a difference: does matched energy supply change the null-neuron deficit, and is it supply, cue or substrate?
design: Co-culture arms on null and wild-type DRG: glucose varied, lactate availability varied, lactate-transport blockade with a tool chosen after a source describing it is read; conditioned medium versus transwell; fixed null neurons; activity block (INV06:X1, X2)
endpoint: Stage shares (PDGFRa, BCAS1, CC1) and MBP wrapping
endpoint_scope: Reports differentiation and wrapping; does not report conduction, viability unless stained, or in vivo energy
comparator: Wild-type DRG with the same arms; a non-metabolic enhancer arm as functional comparator
engagement_check: Medium glucose and lactate measured at the OPC; an OPC-side uptake readout (pH imaging as in the Rinholm abstract)
decision_it_changes: Places the cause in supply, cue or substrate; none of them changes the energy hypothesis from H2 to a proposal
weakened_by: Acid load; Arm B has no source; two independent experiments minimum
